About Orooj

What is estate planning?

Estate planning is the process of determining how your wealth will be protected, managed and distributed, both during your lifetime and after. It goes beyond drafting a will. It is a comprehensive strategy that reflects your values, secures your legacy and supports your loved ones.

A well-structured estate plan helps:

  • Ensure your assets are distributed according to your wishes
  • Minimize tax liabilities and administrative delays
  • Prepare for potential incapacity or health-related challenges
  • Provide clarity and peace of mind for your family

Whether you are planning for retirement, succession or charitable giving, a thoughtful estate plan is essential to preserving what you have built. Orooj Financial Group specializes in personalized estate planning strategies that align with your financial goals, protect your assets and pass your legacy on with intention and care.

Zahid Syed

Founder & CEO

Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Trust and Estate Practitioner (TEP), Master Financial Advisor in Philanthropy (MFA-P)

Email ZahidBook an appointment (opens Calendly in a new tab)

Zahid Syed is the driving force behind Orooj Financial Group, where he has spent over two decades turning complex financial strategies into clear, personalized solutions for clients around the world. As a Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU) and Trust and Estate Practitioner (TEP), Zahid brings a wealth of expertise to every conversation, whether he is helping families preserve their legacies, guiding business owners through succession planning, or crafting customized estate plans.

The TEP designation is recognized globally as the gold standard in trust, estate and wealth planning. It represents not only advanced technical expertise but also a commitment to the highest standards of professional excellence and ethics in guiding families and business owners through complex estate, tax and succession planning.

His mission

  • Helping families protect their legacy
  • Guiding business owners in maximizing value
  • Providing clarity in complex estate and tax planning

A dedicated philanthropist as well as a seasoned advisor, Zahid is deeply committed to giving back to the community and making a lasting impact beyond financial planning. His passion for meaningful change is reflected in both his professional work and his charitable involvement.

Known for his sharp insight and unwavering commitment to client success, Zahid is more than an advisor. He is a trusted partner who genuinely cares about making a difference. His dedication has earned him recognition as a Top of the Table member of the Million Dollar Round Table (MDRT), but he is just as proud of the lasting relationships he has built with clients who consider him family.

Zahid is an active member of several leading industry organizations, including the Conference for Advanced Life Underwriting (CALU), the Estate Planning Council of Mississauga, and the Financial Advisors Association of Canada (Advocis). He also serves as a Brand Ambassador for the Trust for Malnutrition & Stunted Growth (TMSG) and contributes to the community as a member of the Mississauga Foundation Donor Advised Fund.

Outside of work, Zahid enjoys traveling, hitting the open road on his motorcycle and Corvette, and spending quality time with his family.

Trust planning

Tax efficiency, creditor protection and privacy through well-crafted trust structures.

Discuss your plan (opens Calendly in a new tab)

Overview

Trusts are one of the most powerful yet underutilized tools in Canadian estate planning. While long embraced in countries like the U.S. and U.K., trust structures are only now gaining traction in Canada as wealth levels rise.

A well-crafted trust can offer significant advantages over traditional wills, including tax efficiency, protection from creditors and enhanced privacy. Our team of experienced Trust and Estate Practitioners works closely with clients to design trust solutions that align with their family's goals, whether that means shielding assets from matrimonial claims or ensuring a smooth, confidential transfer of wealth across generations.

Planning considerations

What we look at together when trust planning is part of your plan.

  • Tax efficiency compared with a traditional will
  • Protection from creditors
  • Enhanced privacy for your family
  • Shielding assets from matrimonial claims
  • A smooth, confidential transfer of wealth across generations

Generational planning

Preserve family harmony and values while transferring wealth tax-efficiently.

Discuss your plan (opens Calendly in a new tab)

Overview

Passing on wealth is about more than numbers. It is about preserving family harmony and values. Our generational planning services help families navigate the emotional and financial complexities of legacy planning.

Acting as impartial advisors, we facilitate open dialogue among stakeholders and proactively address potential areas of conflict. A key strategy we often employ is the estate freeze, which locks in the current value of assets while allowing future growth to accrue to the next generation. This approach not only defers tax liabilities but also supports a seamless and tax-efficient transfer of wealth.

Planning considerations

What we look at together when generational planning is part of your plan.

  • Impartial, facilitated dialogue among family stakeholders
  • Addressing potential areas of conflict early
  • Estate freezes that lock in the current value of assets
  • Future growth accruing to the next generation
  • Deferred tax liabilities and a tax-efficient transfer

Business succession

Clear, customized exit strategies that protect the business you built.

Discuss your plan (opens Calendly in a new tab)

Overview

For entrepreneurs and family business owners, succession planning is critical to long-term success. Yet nearly 70% of Canadian family businesses fail to transition to the next generation.

We help business owners develop clear, customized exit strategies that align with their retirement goals and protect the legacy they have built. From valuation and tax planning to leadership transition and ownership restructuring, our advisors guide clients through every stage of the succession process, supporting continuity, stability and peace of mind.

Planning considerations

What we look at together when business succession is part of your plan.

  • Exit strategies aligned with your retirement goals
  • Business valuation and tax planning
  • Leadership transition
  • Ownership restructuring
  • Continuity and stability through every stage

Our approach includes trusts for tax efficiency, strategic gifting and tax-deferred investments like RRSPs and TFSAs. With expert guidance and regular reviews, we help you stay compliant, protect global assets and maximize the value passed to your beneficiaries.

Planning considerations

What we look at together when tax planning is part of your plan.

  • Minimizing income tax, capital gains and probate fees
  • Avoiding dual taxation on U.S. or foreign assets
  • Trusts for tax efficiency
  • Strategic gifting
  • Tax-deferred investments such as RRSPs and TFSAs
  • Regular reviews to maintain compliance

Charitable giving

Philanthropy that reflects your values and strengthens your estate's tax efficiency.

Discuss your plan (opens Calendly in a new tab)

Overview

Charitable giving is a powerful way to leave a lasting legacy while enhancing your estate's tax efficiency. By incorporating philanthropy into your estate plan, you can support causes you care about and reduce your overall tax burden.

We help clients structure charitable donations through wills, foundations or scholarship funds, so their values continue to make an impact. Tax benefits include claiming up to 75% of net income annually, and up to 100% in the year of death, significantly reducing estate taxes.

Whether you are looking to support a specific organization or create a long-term charitable vehicle, we provide expert advice so your giving is both meaningful and financially strategic.

Planning considerations

What we look at together when charitable giving is part of your plan.

  • Donations structured through wills, foundations or scholarship funds
  • Claiming donations up to 75% of net income annually
  • Up to 100% of net income in the year of death
  • Supporting a specific organization or a long-term charitable vehicle

Who we serve

We help physicians, professionals, business owners and wealthy families across Mississauga and the GTA build, protect and transfer their wealth with confidence.

Physicians & corporate professionals

As a physician or corporate professional, you have worked hard to build a successful career and accumulate significant assets. Without a proactive estate plan, however, a large portion of your wealth could be lost to taxes. We help professionals safeguard their estates and pass on their legacy efficiently and according to their wishes.

Our approach includes:

  • Customized estate plans aligned with your career, family and financial goals
  • Tax-efficient strategies such as estate freezes, pipeline planning and corporate will structures
  • Corporate insured retirement plans and asset transfer strategies
  • Charitable giving and loss carryback planning to reduce tax liabilities

With expert guidance, you can gain peace of mind knowing your estate is protected and your intentions are clearly documented.

Related services

Tax planningPersonal & corporate insurance planningWill & probate planningCharitable giving

Business owners

Entrepreneurs face unique challenges when it comes to estate and succession planning. We take a comprehensive, architected approach, bringing together legal, tax, investment and insurance expertise to build a strategy that supports both your business and your personal legacy.

Our team helps business owners:

  • Protect and transition business assets efficiently
  • Minimize tax exposure through corporate structuring and insurance strategies
  • Plan for succession with clarity and confidence
  • Secure long-term financial security for both the business and the family

We are committed to helping you leave more to your loved ones and charitable causes while minimizing the burden of taxation and administrative complexity.

Related services

Business successionPersonal & corporate insurance planningTax planningGenerational planning

Wealthy families

For ultra-high-net-worth families, estate planning is about more than preserving wealth. It is about shaping a legacy that endures. Families with a net worth of $30 million or more face complex financial landscapes that require sophisticated, customized solutions.

Our estate planning services for affluent families focus on:

  • Strategic tax minimization and intergenerational wealth transfer
  • Conflict prevention through clear governance and trustee selection
  • Protection against probate delays, asset vulnerability and business disruption
  • Philanthropic planning through trusts, foundations and charitable structures

We work closely with families to design dynamic estate plans that evolve with their needs, so their wealth supports future generations and meaningful causes.
